name: ⚔️ Lantern Legends: Dungeon Loot
description: Grab your lantern and dive into the dungeons! Pick a class (Knight, Ranger, Mage or Lightbringer), fight waves of cartoon monsters, dodge the red circles and defeat giant bosses. Every enemy can drop loot in a glowing beam: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary and Mythic gear with special powers. Team up with up to 4 friends, clear 6 dungeons on Normal, Hard and Nightmare, enhance your gear at the Forge and climb the leaderboard! Friends in your server give +10% gold and XP each.
